verdict.line: You lose if you stand and trade through Sett's stored Grit and empowered Q autos; you win if you poke with Q/E and disengage before he unloads.

brief.thesis: Sett has no dash and wins fights by soaking damage into Grit for W (Haymaker) and landing empowered Q (Knuckle Down) autos in extended brawls. Aatrox's E (Umbral Dash) and multi-swing Q (The Darkin Blade) are built for hit-and-run poke, not standing trades, which is exactly why OP.GG flags prolonged melee fights as the losing pattern here. Play it as poke-and-reset and the 51.1% win rate over 3,880 games, plus the solo-kill edge, is yours to take.

theirWindow.when: Grit near max and Q up
theirWindow.what: He's about to cash in W (Haymaker) for a true-damage center hit plus physical sides, backed by Q's empowered autos. Disengage with E (Umbral Dash) rather than continuing to trade autos.

yourWindow.when: your E and Q both off cooldown
yourWindow.what: Dash in with E (Umbral Dash, cooldown 9/8/7/6/5s) to heal off the hit, drop a Q (The Darkin Blade) swing, then dash back out before his Facebreaker or empowered Q lands.

playing.title: Poke, don't brawl
playing.detail: Dash in with E (Umbral Dash), drop a Q (The Darkin Blade) swing, then dash out before his empowered autos land. OP.GG's own read on this matchup is that prolonged melee fights are the losing pattern.

playing.title: Track his Grit bar
playing.detail: Sett's passive Pit Grit stores incoming damage for W (Haymaker). If it's climbing high, back off instead of continuing to trade, since he gets a free shield plus true-damage center hit and physical side hits once he casts it.

playing.title: Respect empowered Q autos
playing.detail: Sett's Q (Knuckle Down, cooldown 9/8/7/6/5s) empowers his next two attacks with bonus max-health damage and grants him move speed toward you. If he's walking at you with Q up, don't stand and trade autos.

playing.title: Stay off both his flanks
playing.detail: Sett's E (Facebreaker, cooldown 16/14.5/13/11.5/10s, range 490) stuns if it pulls enemies from both sides together, but only slows if you're on one side. Fight from one side near minions so a hit only slows you.

playing.title: All-in at level 6
playing.detail: Your R (World Ender, cooldown 120/100/80/80/80s) fears nearby minions and buffs your AD, healing, and move speed. Use this spike to force the extended fight once, since your healing and damage edge are strongest right when it comes online.

playing.title: Hold E around his R
playing.detail: Sett's R (The Show Stopper, cooldown 120/100/80/80/80s, range 400) carries you through the air and slams you, slowing nearby enemies on landing. Keep E (Umbral Dash) available near his level 6 so you can reposition before or right after he grabs you.

playing.title: Front-load your burst
playing.detail: Only commit to an extended exchange once your Q is building toward its third swing or Deathbringer Stance is up, matching the matchup's measured solo-kill advantage to your own cooldown timing.

brief.patchCaveat: Build paths, runes, summoners, and all win-rate/pick-rate numbers above are measured from current-patch games on OP.GG; the ability breakdowns, timing windows, and tactical reasoning are my own read on how to play those numbers out in lane.

stats.opponentTip: Do not try to fight Sett through prolonged melee fights. Keep some distance while using your abilities come off cooldown to deal burst damage.
